pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   C. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Work has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   C. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   B. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The call of Moses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Baptism of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Calming the Storm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

7. B — Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. D — Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The call of Moses; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of John the Baptist; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Baptism of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Calming the Storm; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
